_help: Scene library for the AI stills and clips (pipeline/ai_gen.py, owner 2026-10-20). kind: object (the bag alone, no person), worn (worn on the shoulder, frame cut below the chin), hand (a hand holds it, no head). {noun} = handbag / backpack ..., {colour} = the colour of the reference photo. tags = words a ugc script phrase can match (the clip is chosen for a phrase that says them). nouns: the product kinds a scene fits (missing = all). clip.model: kling3_0 (still scenes, 3 s) or minimax_hailuo (walking / hands, 6 s trimmed). Add scenes here: ai_gen never picks one used in the product's last 3 batches (data/novelty_log.json).
style: Photorealistic candid lifestyle photograph, natural light, shot on a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, true-to-life colours, fine film grain, no text, no logos, no watermark.
keep: The exact {noun} from the reference image, unchanged: same colour{colour_note}, same shape and proportions, same handles or straps, same zipper pulls and hardware, same stitching and finish. Do not redesign it.
face: The picture contains no face at all: nobody is looking at the camera and no eyes, nose or mouth are visible; the top edge of the frame cuts the person off at shoulder height.

motion.object: Subtle realistic handheld camera, slow gentle push-in toward the {noun}, soft natural light shifts a little, small ambient movement in the background. The {noun} stays exactly the same shape, colour and details, no morphing. No people.
motion.worn: Candid footage, steady camera follows the woman as she walks away from the camera, the {noun} sways gently on her shoulder, background softly blurred. The {noun} stays exactly the same shape, colour and details, no morphing. The frame stays cut at shoulder height: no face visible.
motion.hand: A hand gently lifts and swings the {noun} a little by its handles, camera steady with a slight push-in, soft natural light. The {noun} stays exactly the same shape, colour and details, no morphing. No face, no head in frame.
